tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gsung thor bu'i skor bzhugs so/ /gsung lan/mkhas pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan lags/ /nyid gsung lha yi rnga chen ni/ /bdag gis legs par mjal bas spa
༄༅/ /gsung thor bu'i skor bzhugs so/ /gsung lan/mkhas pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan lags/ /nyid gsung lha yi rnga chen ni/ /bdag gis legs par mjal bas spa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung thor bu'i skor bzhugs so// gsung lan/ mkhas pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan lags/ /nyid gsung lha yi rnga chen ni/ /bdag gis legs par mjal bas spro/ /'on kyang kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la/ /gnas snang gnyis su phyes pa 'dis/ /dbyangs can dgyes pa klu sgrub rjes/ /gsal stong phra rags dwangs snyigs su/ /phyes dang gcig tu babs par nges/ /der skyon thams cad bzlog par dka'/ /chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag zhig /zhal gyis bzhes las thabs ci zhig /chos can phung khams skye mched sogs/ /'khrul pa ma dag ltar snang rnams/ /dag pa'i lam gyis sbyang ba na/ /rang bzhin dag 'gyur mi bzhed cing / /de phyir chos can thams cad pa/ /gdod nas dag pa nyid kyis so/ /des na gzhan stong dbu ma che'i/ /kun brtags glo bur sbyang bya dang / /yongs grub rang bzhin 'gyur med du/ /bshad dang dgongs gcig nyid 'gyur phyir/ /de skyon mang du smras pa rnams/ /rang gi steng du 'khor ba'am/ /shin tu bzlog par dka' ba 'o/ /blo rin kun gzhi bshad pa rnams/ /rdzogs chen nyid dang lto sbyar ba/ /rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab dang / /thad ka nyid du 'grig dka' bas/ /de yi dgag bzhag thams cad legs/ /gzim 'og thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /rnam shes ye shes dbye ba ni/ /kun gzhi sngar med ye shes zhig /'khor 'das dbyer med lta bsgoms nas/ /gsar du skye ba 'dra zhig gsungs/ /de ltar na ni ye shes kyi/ /don dang 'gal ba lta ci smros/ /tshig kyang 'gal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de min rgyu rgyud kun gzhir zhog /kun gzhi las gzhan ye shes su/ /'jog pa'i gzhi ni ci zhig yod/ /kun gzhi thabs kyis zin pa na/ /ye shes nyid las gzhan med do/ /yang ni skabs 'gar sgrib med kyi/ /gsal rig gnyug ma lhan skyes bzhed/ /de ltar na ni kun gzhi yi/ /mtshan nyid gsal rig ma 'gags pa/ /de ga yin nam logs shig yin/ /de yin kun gzhi'i nang du bzhag

/de min da lta bskyang rgyu yi/ /gsal rig gang yin smra bar rigs/ /lar ni rgyu rgyud kun gzhi yi/ /rang gi ngo bo mtshan nyid de/ /rje btsun gong mas brtags pa ltar/ /'jog las de yi gnas lugs ngor/ /dbye ba gnyis su bya mi rigs/ /thabs kyis zin dang ma zin nas/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par gyis/ /gnas snang gnyis su dbye na 'thad/ /de ni rtogs ldan ngo skal las/ /kun gzhi'i gnas lugs nyid ma yin/ /gal te gnyis su 'dod gyur na/ /rgyu rgyud kun gzhi gnyis su thal/ /de phyir bdag 'dra blun rmongs kyis/ /mkhas pa'i gsung la brtag mi 'os/ /'on kyang ring nas 'dris pa yis/ /a mtshar nyid du gang byung bris/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐// ༈ /rgyal ba kun kyi ye shes sku/ /'jam dbyangs ngur smrig bla gos can/ /chos kyi blo gros zhabs pad ni/ /kun dga' bdag gi gtsug na rgyal/ /khyod gsung sprin gyi rnga gsang ni/ /sprang ban mdongs mtha'i rna ba ru/ /son pa'i mod la blo gros lus/ /dga' ba'i gar gyis rtsen par byas/ /thugs brtses nyams mtshar tshul du ni/ /dri ba'i tshig 'ga' gnang ba la/ /rmongs pas spobs pa bskyed nas ni/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis 'di skad zhu/ /snyigs ma'i dus su thub pa yi/ /bstan pa tshul bzhin 'dzin pa ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /'jam mgon legs pa'i mtshan can te/ /dam pa de yis sa skya pa'i/ /rang lugs yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ /mthon po'i rtse mor legs mchod de/ /zab rgyas chos kyi gru char ni/ /kun la snyoms par phab pa'i tshe/ /gdul bya rang gi mos pa dang / /sngon gyi las smon bye brag gis/ /chu snod dbang gis zla gzugs bzhin/ rang rang bgo skal so sor gyur/ /bdag ni chos rje 'di nyid la/ /sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes yod/ /mi phyed gus pa'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /sdug bsngal gtam ngan khyad bsad nas/

/don yod rnam bzhis mnyes par byas/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i dam bca' blangs/ /thugs brtse'i thugs kyis rjes bzung nas/ /gsang chen gsung ngag gdams pa'i gter/ /pha nor bu la sbyin pa bzhin/ /bdag la dgyes bzhin gnang bar mdzad/ /des na kho bo'i gzhung nyid du/ /kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ngos 'dzin la/ /gnas snang gnyis su phye ba ni/ /gzhi la rmongs pa spong ba'i phyir/ /bden gnyis rnam dbye byas pa ste/ /snang tshul kun rdzob yin pa dang / /gnas tshul don dam lags pa'i phyir/ /mdo rgyud 'ga' dang de dag gi /dgongs 'grel rnams su kun gzhi ni/ /bag chags bgo ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i/ /gsal rig tsam la gsungs pa dang / /nam yang 'gyur ba med pa yi/ /dbyings la dgongs te gsungs pa dang / /rig stong zung du 'jug pa la/ /dgongs te gsungs pa du ma mthong / /de dag dgongs pa'ang gsal phyir yin/ /dri ma med pa'i lugs bzang 'di'i/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad du/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug dgongs phyir dang / /khyad par du yang lam dus su/ /rten 'byung stong dang stong pa nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'char ba yi/ /tshul 'di legs par rtogs nas ni/ /'khor 'das bsre ba'i gsang gnad kyis/ /ma dag 'khrul pa'i snang ba kun/ /dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid du/ /mthong nas sa lam bgrod pa la/ /phan phyir bdag gis bshad pa lags/ /klu sgrub rgya mtshos lam dus su/ /'khor 'das dbyer med sgom pa'i tshe/ /rig pa dwangs snyigs phyes pa ni/ /snyigs ma bor nas dwangs ma ni/ /mngon du byed pa lta bur gsungs/ /kun rdzob spangs nas don dam ni/ /rtogs zhes dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /rje btsun gong ma mi bzhed lags/ /gnas snang gnyis su phye ba ni/ /'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ /rgyan po pa yi dris lan dang / /rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan sogs na snang / /dwangs snyigs gnyis su phye ba ni/ /khong las brgyud 'dzin gong ma yi/ /khrid gzhung rnams su bshad pa med/

/des na 'di gnyis mi mtshungs so/ /gzim 'og thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /ye shes gsar skyes yod gsungs pa/ /so so'i skye bo'i gnas skabs na/ /ye shes gtan nas med pa dang / /mos spyod skabs su don spyi tsam/ /mthong ba'i lam du ye shes mchog /gsar du skye bar bzhed pa ni/ /rgya bod mkhas grub phal cher mthun/ /khong yang de yi rjes 'brang lags/ /gzhan yang sngon gyi skyes chen rnams/ /la la ye shes med par gsungs/ /'ga' zhig ye shes yod ces bzhed/ /bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ /ji snyed zhu ba lung ston phyir/ /thams cad mkhyen la ye shes mnga'/ /chos dbyings spros bral brnyes pa na/ /ye shes med par gsungs pa'ang yod/ /zhes sogs rnam par phye ste gsungs/ /gzhan stong dbu ma chen po yis/ /ye shes gdod nas yod par gsungs/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung 'ga' las/ /ka dag dbyings kyi ngos la ni/ /ye shes med par gsungs pa'ang mthong / /de sogs bzhed pa mang na yang / /skabs don min pas re zhig bzhag /kho bos byas pa'i legs bshad rnams/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum dang / /gong ma brgyud par bcas pa yi/ /gsung rab rnams dang mthun pa'i tshul/ /smra la cung zad dbang ba ste/ /pha rgod bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi/ /zla shel 'dzum pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /blo gros chu gter 'phel ba dang / legs bshad ku mud dgod par byas/ /de slad mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i/ /zhabs sen pad+ma rā ga'i rdul/ /tshangs gnas mdzes pa'i gtsug rgyan du/ /thob pa'i skal bzang myong ba'i tshe/ /gus bcas rang gi mgrin lam nas/ /zhu bar 'os kyi gzhan du min/ /rtag chad med pa'i rang lugs 'di/ /sgro skur med pa'i ring lugs kyis/ /nor 'khrul med par bshad pa la/ /phyogs lhung med par gzigs par zhu/ /zhu mchid pad+mo'i gzhon nu'i tshom bu de/ /rab gus dad pa'i sor bcus legs btegs nas/ /mgon khyod dgyes pa'i mchod pa'i ched du 'bul/

/thugs brtse'i spyan ras g.yo bar mdzad du gsol/ /slad char khyod zhabs rdo rje'i khams ltar brtan/ /dgyes zhal nyin byed 'dzum pa'i gsung zer gyis/ /gus phran pad+mo'i dga' tshal legs skyong ba'i/ /skal bzang myur du 'byung ba'i smon 'dun zhu/ /sgyu lus phung po rkyen gyis ma zhig tshe/ /khyod zhabs pad phreng spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsten/ /rnyog bral thugs brtse'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang po/ /snying gi bcud du nam zhig thob par 'gyur/ /gu ru rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ skyabs sems lan gsum nas/ rang mdun nam mkha' 'ja' 'od klung / /rtsa ba'i bla ma thod phreng rtsal/ /brgyud gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtshos bskor/ /skyabs kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor bzhugs/ /gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus ci rigs nas/ sid+dhi bzla/ mthar 'dod gsol bya/ bsdu rim/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis/ /byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thob/ /bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim/ /dbyer med ma bcos lhug par bzhag /ces ka dag spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon bya'o// ༈ /rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /mgon med snyigs ma'i 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu/ /pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar༞ srung ma'i 'khu ldog zhi bar༞ byad dang rbad gtong bzlog par༞ nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi bar༞ rgud pa mtha' dag zhi bar༞ mi nor phyugs gsum 'phel bar༞ tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par༞ dge legs yon tan 'phel bar༞ bsam don myur du 'grub par༞ 'gro ba yongs la bu ltar brtse ba dang / /khyad par kha ba can gyi 'gro ba rnams/ /lnga bdo'i snyigs ma'i rgud pas mnar ba na/ /thugs rjes myur du bskyab par zhal bzhes shing / /mkhyen brtse nus mthu thogs pa ma mchis pa'i/

/mgon po khyed kyi thugs dam ji bzhin du/ /da lta nyid du byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /'jig rten bde skyid ldan par mdzad du gsol/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs sprin bzhin 'thib par mdzod/ /byin rlabs char rgyun myur du 'bebs par mdzod/ /rkyen ngan bar chad dri ma dag par mdzod/ /phan bde'i lo tog rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha yi byin mthu dang / /rten 'byung bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar gsol ba btab bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ //drang nges/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa mtshungs med thub pa'i dbang po dang / /'dren pa mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs pad la/ /sgo gsum g.yo med gus pas phyag byas te/ /dri med lung don cung zad bdag gis dbye/ /spyir gsung rab kyi drang nges 'byed tshul la/ /grub mtha' so so'i bzhed tshul mi mthun te/ bye brag smra ba rnams bka' rnams ni gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis sna tshogs su gsungs pas drang don mang la/ chos kyi phung po la sogs pa'i mngon pa sde bdun gyi bstan bcos rnams nges don yin zhes 'dod/ brjod bya la'ang / shes pa skad cig cha med dang / gzung ba rdul phran cha med bden par yod pa bshad pa de nges don gyi mdo yin par bye mdo gnyis ka 'dod la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa pa rnams phyi don yod par bstan pa'i mdo rnams drang don dang / snang ba sems su gsungs shing mtshan nyid gsum bstan pa'i mdo rnams nges don du bzhed/ dbu ma gzhan stong pa rnams/ bde gshegs snying po rtag brtan bden grub tu ston pa rnams nges don dang / bka' bar pa drang don zhes gsungs pa yang byung mod/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal mgon klu'i dgongs pa ltar/ dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs kyis/ stong pa bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa ltar/ /nges don mdo sde dag gi bye brag shes/ /gang las sems can gang zag skyes bu bstan/

/chos de thams cad drang ba'i don du shes/ /zhes mdo drangs nas drang nges mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba shin tu mang zhing / kho bo yang 'di'i rjes su 'jug par 'dod do/ /skabs don slob dpon rin po ches spyi rnam du byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi mdo'i lung drangs nas/ drang nges kyi 'byed tshul brgyad yod par gsungs pa'i dang po ni/ lam la 'jug pa drang don dang / /'bras bu la 'jug nges pa'i don/ /zhes pa ni phar phyin drug sogs lam gyi dbye ba ston pa drang don dang / gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu sa bcu dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ston pa mdo sde sa bcu pa lta bu la nges don du byas kyang rung mod 'dir mdo sngags spyi'i drang nges 'byed pa'i skabs yin pas/ 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po dag /bcom ldan nges par gsungs lags na/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing / /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi tshol ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs/ /zhes pa'i lan du/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyu lam du byed pa phar phyin theg pa lta bu drang don dang / 'bras bu lam du byed pa rdo rje theg pa nges don du byas na 'thad par sems lags/ gnyis pa kun rdzob sgrub byed drang don dang / don dam sgrub byed nges pa'i don/ zhes pa ni kun rdzob thabs kyi cha ston pa rnams drang don yin te/ legs par dpyad na ma grub cing / /chos nyid rtogs byed kyi thabs kyi cha yin pa'i phyir/ gnas lugs spros pa dang bral bar gsungs pa rnams nges don te/ thabs las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin zhing dngos po'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa rtogs shing shes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa las kyi bya ba la 'jug drang / /las dang nyon mongs zad ston nges/ /zhes pa las rgyu 'bras yod par gsungs pa drang don dang /

de med par gsungs pa nges don du byas nas gang zag gnyis kyi nyams len la sbyor bar mdzad pa'ang yod la/ tshig gi 'bru snon bde yang rab dbye las/ lta ba ston pa'i lung dang bsgom pa dang spyod pa ston pa'i lung rnams lung sbyor gyi gnas skabs so sor shes dgos par gsungs pa ltar gang zag gcig gi nyams len la sbyar rgyu byas na lta bas spyod sgom khyad du mi gsod cing sgom spyod gnyis dmigs gtad 'dzin zhen gyis mi 'ching ba'i dgos pa yod par sems lags/ bzhi pa kun nas nyon mongs bstan pa drang / /rnam byang bstan pa nges pa'i don/ /zhes pa gzugs nas rten 'brel gyi bar dang sbyin pa nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar ston pa lta bu'am yang na rten 'brel lugs 'byung ldog ston pa lta bu la byas na/ snga ma la rang rang gi ngo bo tsam smos pas chog la phyi ma la srid pa'i rtsa ba ma rig pa spong ba la stong pa nyid bstan dgos pa'i phyir dang 'di'i drang nges 'byed tshul brgyad po 'di gnas skabs kyi brjod tshul dang dgag dgos kyi ldog pa mi 'dra yang / mthar thug gi dgongs pa dpal ldan zla ba'i bzhed pa dang mi 'gal ba zhig dgos sam snyam lags te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi dgongs pa de kho na nyid la 'bab de kho na nyid la gzhol zhes dang / 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu/ /nga yis mdo rnams gang gsungs pa/ /yi ge tha dad don gcig ste/ /yongs su bsgrags par nus ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nges don yin na stong nyid ston pas khyab pa khas blangs dgos sam snyam lags/ lnga pa 'khor ba skyo bskyed drang don dang / /'khor 'das gnyis med nges pa'i don/ /zhes pa gnas skabs 'khor ba la skyo ba bskyed pa'i thabs su sangs rgyas kyis kyang las kyi rnam par smin pa myong bar gsungs pa dang / mi rtag pa dang mi gtsang ba la sogs pa bstan pa dang dngos po'i gnas lugs spros pa thams cad dang bral bar gsungs pa lta bu la bshad du btub mod tshig phyi ma'i nus pa la dpags na 'khor 'das tha dad du ston pa nyan thos kyi mdo sde dang /

srid zhi gnyis med ston pa theg pa chen po'i sde snod lta bu lags sam snyam/ drug pa tshig 'bru sna tshogs ston pa drang / /zab cing rtogs dka' nges pa'i don/ /zhes pa phar phyin drug po lta bu re re la'ang dbye ba mang po mdzad nas thabs kun rdzob gtso bor mdzad de spros pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa dang / stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dgongs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa lta bu yin nam snyam lags/ bdun pa tshig mang sems can mgu byed drang / /tshig nyung bzung bde nges pa'i don/ /zhes pa phung khams skye mched dang de la'ang dmigs bcas dmigs med thogs bcas thogs med sogs kyi rnam dbye rgyas par phye nas phyi don yod par gsungs pa lta bu dang / gang zag dbang rnon la dgongs nas/ tshig nyung ngus gnas lugs kyi don ston par mdzad pa rnams so/ /brgyad pa bdag sogs gtsor bshad drang ba'i don/ bdag med bstan pa nges pa'i don/ /zhes pa bdag 'dzin can rnams drang ba'i phyir du nga de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal bu 'di zhes bya bar gyur to zhes dang / las byed pa po dang rnam smin myong ba po yod par gsungs pa lta bu dang / bdag med pa'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin ston pa rnams so/ /mdor na drang don dang nges don zhes pa'i go ba rtogs bya mthar thug gam dngos po'i yin lugs de kho na nyid du nges shing de las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i don ston pa la nges don dang / gnas lugs de rtogs pa'i thabs su gsungs pa dngos bstan de chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi don can du ston pa drang ste bshad dgos pa'i don la drang don zer ba yin pas/ gnas skabs zab khyad cung zad yod pa lta bu la go mi rung snyam lags te mgon po byams pas/ mdo sde rgyan du dgongs pa bzhi dang / ldem dgongs bzhi gsungs pa/ rgyal sras rin po che'i 'grel par gsung rab thams cad 'di brgyad kyi nang du 'dus par gsungs mod/

'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhal snga nas brgyad po drang don yin par gsungs shing / kun mkhyen rong ston chen po'ang 'di bzhin bzhed cing / rje blo bzang grags pas kyang de bzhin du legs bshad gser phreng du gsungs 'dug pas grub mtha' gzhan gyis nges don du byas pa gzhan gyi drang don du 'chad pa yod mod/ rang nyid kyis nges don du khas blangs pa phyis drang don du 'gyur mi rung bar sems lags/ gting dpag dka' ba thub pa'i gsung gi don/ /rmongs pa bdag gis dbye bar mi nus mod/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin phyogs tsam smras pa la/ /nongs pa mchis na snying nas mthol zhing bshags/ /cung zad legs par bshad pa'i cha mchis na/ /dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i bran du bdag skyes nas/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i skal pa yod par shog /ces pa chos smra ba'i gzugs brnyan kunam̐ dgam̐' rgyam̐l mtsham̐n gyis gus pas bris pa'o// //dge'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// //dus dran/ skyob pa mtshungs med ston pa thugs rje can/ /khyed kyi dgag sgrub gnang ba'i bslab pa las/ /rkyen gyi dbang gis gnang bar 'os pa rnams/ /dus la dgongs te bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /phan mdzad khyed kyi bstan pa'i rjes 'jug nas/ /bstan pa'i mjug 'dir lam la rab gus pa'i/ /dge ba 'di yi tshe rabs thams cad kun/ /mgon po khyod kyi bka' bzhin 'grub par shog /'pho ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir gshin po la 'pho ba 'debs mkhan ma rnyed pa'am/ rnyed kyang rgyab rten gsol 'debs kyi tshul du/ 'pho ba'i dmigs rim smon lam gyi tshul du 'don par 'dod na/ mdun mkhar yid 'phrog 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong / /seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po 'od dpag med/ /skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba/ /bdag dang dmigs yul 'gro ba ma lus la/ /rjes su brtse ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/

de nas gsol 'debs dang / mtshan sogs brjod la/ skye 'chi bar do'i 'khrul snang ma zhig pa/ /dmigs yul tshe 'das 'di yi rnam shes ni/ /'chi med lam nas skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin/ /rje btsun bla ma'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ /skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /'khrul ba'i sems dang rje btsun bla ma'i thugs/ /gnyis med mnyam pa chen por ma bcos aḥ rgyu des las ngan sdig sgrib kun sbyangs nas/ /'khrul snang bar do'i 'jigs skrag mi 'char bar/ /ngan song ngan 'gro'i skye sgo bcad nas ni/ /dag pa'i zhing du dge ba'i 'phro mthud de/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla mas rjes bzung nas/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /zhes pa 'di ni dus dbang gis dgos pa cung zad mthong nas/ rdo rje grogs po rnams kyi mos pa bzhin du kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bris/ dge'o dge'o tshe 'das 'gro la dge/ //maṅga laṃ// //phyag sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis phyag 'tshal bas/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad thob par shog cig snyam nas phyag 'tshal// // mar me'i smon lam/ 'od kyis stong gsum gsal bar nus pa yi/ /lha rdzas mar me'i phreng ba dpag med kyis/ /rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod par bgyi/ /dge bas bdag gis bsags pa'i sdig ltung dang / /shes nyon sgrib pa'i mun pa kun spangs nas/ /spyan dang mngon shes snang ba mchog thob ste/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam chos mdzod bzung nas/ /zang zing med pa'i chos kyi snang ba yis/ /'gro ba'i rmongs pa'i mun pa sel bar shog

/bden stobs/ skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po khyed kyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam mthar phyin/ mkhyen brtse nus mthu thogs pa ma mchis pa mnga' ba'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis/ bdag nyid 'brel thogs dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i las ngan pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i rkyen ngan pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs nas yang dag pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rnams myur du bdag gi rgyud la skye bar gyur cig bsten cing rgyun du mchod pa'i srung ma thams cad dbang du 'dus nas kha ton dge sbyor mtshams bsnyen sgrub/ rnam dkar gyi bya ba gang bsgrub thams cad lam du 'gro zhing mthar phyin pa dang / gnas skabs kyi bsam don mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub nas don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par gyur cig 'chi kha gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi myong zhing bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas mdun bsus te/ phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can du skye thub par gyur cig de bzhin du 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i gsung gis sgrogs shing dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs par gyur cig ༈ /skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po khyed kyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam mthar phyin/ mkhyen brtse nus mthu thogs pa ma mchis pa mnga' ba'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis/ bdag gi pha ma gnyis dang 'brel ba thogs pa'i shi gson thams cad kyis gtsos byas sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog med kyi dus nas bsags pa'i las ngan pa'i sdig sgrib spyi dang /

bla ma dkon mchog la ma gus pa bgyis pa/ sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba/ shi gson gyi dad zas zos pa/ sha khrag gi zas la spyod pa/ grib ma drug gis phog pa sogs sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i rmis ltas mtshan ltas mo rtsis ngan pa tshe gegs bar chad nad gdon blo nyes dgra gyod 'khon gsum phyi nang gi gdug pa can rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'khrugs rtsod nog brjod log sgrub dam sel bsnyen sgrub kyi bar chad sogs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la yid ches kyi dad pa/ byang chub kyi sems/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab/ rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rnams myur du bdag gi rgyud la skye bar gyur cig mgon po lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi yum sring / stag zhon 'khor bcas/ dur bdag yab yum/ lha mo rje khol/ chos rgyal chen po sku lnga/ gnod sbyin chen po mched bdun srung ma dam can rgya mtsho dbang du 'dus nas kha ton dge sbyor/ mtshams bsnyen sgrub rnam dkar gyi bya ba gang sgrub thams cad lam du 'gro zhing mthar phyin pa dang / gnas skabs kyi bsam don mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub nas don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par gyur cig 'chi kha gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi myong zhing bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas mdun bsus te/ phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can du skye thub par gyur cig de bzhin du 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bden pa'i gsung gis sgrogs shing dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs par gyur cig bden stobs gsar pa/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las kyi rang gzugs rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs/

༄༅/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs/ bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams kyi skye dgu yongs kyi gtsug gi nor bu o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po sogs/ rig 'dzin gyi grub thob rgya mtsho/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ste/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyi sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam mthar phyin bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan/ dbang cu'i dbang gis phyug mkhyen brtse nus gsum thogs pa ma mchis pa mnga' ba'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis/ yul phyogs 'di nyid kyis thog drang ba'i yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du char chu dus su babs/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa sogs dge legs kyi snang ba gong du 'phel zhing / nad mug mtshon gsum gyi bskal pa rgyun chad/ bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston la longs spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig bye brag tu byang re tshe gnam mtsho phyug mor grags pa'i nor 'dzin yangs pa'i tha grur gnas bcas pa'i 'brog sde wa shul sde gzhung ma'i dgon yul gnyis kyi mi phyugs 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i mi nad dang / phyugs nad/ lo nyes dang / gangs zhod/ rmi ltas mtshan ltas ngan pa dgra rkun jag gsum gyi 'tshe ba/ rgya bod kyi nyer 'tshe sogs 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad lhag med du zhi bar gyur cig mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa/ 'khor dang longs spyod snyan grags bde skyid thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig ljongs 'di'i nye 'khor dang bcas pa'i skye bo phal cher gyi sems rgyud la zhugs nas 'khon 'dzin dang 'thab rtsod nog brjod dang /

nad yams sogs mi bde ba du ma'i sna 'dren byas te yul khams phung la sbyor bar byed pa'i rgyal 'gong dam sri gdug pa can rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad dus skad cig nyid du dmigs med chos kyi dbyings su nye bar zhi bar gyur cig las ngan gyi dbang gis 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor nyes pa dang / sdong grogs ngan pa'i rkyen dbang gis da lta shi 'dre gdon gzugs su skyes nas 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa la longs spyod cing gzhan la gnod pa 'ba' zhig byed pa de dag rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi stobs kyi rang snang ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang thams cad lhag med du zhi nas/ las smon bzang po mtshams sbyor byas te/ mngon mtho'i rten la rnam dkar lha chos bsgrub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig ljongs 'di'i skye bo mchog dman thams cad bla ma dang dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og tu tshud nas dkon mchog dang las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa sogs shes rab nor bdun gyis mngon par phyug cing mthong chos tshe 'di nyid la'ang bde skyid kyi dpal la longs spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig gzhan yang gros la dbang ba thams cad blo sems shin tu mthun zhing nog brjod med par chos srid la phan pa'i bsam don thams cad gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig spyir sangs rgyas kyi lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig de 'dzin gyi skyes bu gang na su bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyi sku tshe bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan cing / thugs kyi bzhed don thams cad gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig khyad par du chos sde chen po bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling gi dge 'dun mchog dman thams cad thugs mthun khrims gtsang chos spyod bcu sogs rnam dkar dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' zhing phrin las kyi snang ba gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig

chos sde 'di'i khri la mnga' gsol ba'i bla sprul dam pa rnams kyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad thams cad lhag med du zhi nas zhabs pad yun ring du brtan cing thugs kyi bzhed don thams cad gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub ste/ ma rmad pa'i phrin las kyi 'od snang chen pos nyam thag re ltos can gyi 'gro ba rnams kyi mi mthun rgud pa'i smag rum rings du bsal nas/ bde skyid kyi dpal la longs spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig nges 'byung dang skyo shes kyis rgyud bskul te snying nas chos la gzhol ba rnams/ phyi nang bdud kyi bar chad thams cad dang bral zhing / mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad lhun gyis grub te sgrub 'bras lung rtogs chos kyi dga' ston myong ba'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las kyi rang gzugs gdul bya ma dag pa'i snang ngor sku gsung thugs rten gyi rnam par shar ba'i rten gsum byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di rnams ma 'ongs bskal pa'i bar du chag 'jig med par gnas shing da dung snang brnyan sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa gong 'phel du 'gro ba dang / skye rgu kun gyis dad gus kyis gtsug tu bkur te/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bus rtag par mchod de/ mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba thams cad kyi rgyud la thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon rma med pa thebs nas rnam dkar dam chos sgrub pa'i skal pa ldan par gyur cig bdag cag rnams kyi chos min gyis spyod pa spyad pa dam tshig nyams chag tu gyur pa dang gsol mchod chag pa sogs dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig ljongs 'di'i phan bde sgrub pa'i bya ba la g.yo med cing tshul bzhin du sgrub pa rnams la rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bka' bzhin du skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par grogs mdzad par gyur cig

gnas gzhi yul gyi bdag po kram chen lha ri zhal dkar/ stobs ldan mahā ro ṣa/ nam mtsho phyug mo'i klu rgyal/ g.yu rtse khra dga'/ sha mtha' sha bsang rdzong skyor mo ni sogs lha klu bdud btsan gyi rigs su gtogs pa'i gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad spyi dang / khyad par du ljongs 'di'i skye bo ngan pa'i rtsub spyod kyis snad cing 'khrugs pa sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad lhag med du zhi bar gyur cig mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig bdag cag mi phyugs 'khor dang bcas pa la gzhi byes lam gsum kun tu srungs skyobs sba ba'i sdong grogs byed par gyur cig mdor na bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / 'dir 'brel ba bzhag pa'i gshin gson thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po 'di la brten nas gnas skabs lha mi'i rten bzang brgyud mar thob te/ mtho ris yon tan bdun gyi rgyan dang mi 'bral bar bde skyid kyi dpal la longs spyod pa dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad nas/ dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i skal pa dang ldan nas/ sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bgrod nas rnam mkhyen yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig de ltar bden tshig 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i gsung gis sgrogs shing dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs par gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// //yang ja mchod dang bkra shis sogs kyi skabs/ rgyal kun phrin las rang gzugs nag po che/ /gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon/

/ngag dbang legs pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sogs kha bsgyur mdzad do/ /'di zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg skabs 'dod gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod gnas bdag gzhi bdag dmigs dgos gang yod skyabs shul dgon yul gnyis sogs/ mdor na mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen gnas mal zas gos yo byad sogs la 'khri ba'i grib gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung / srung ma dang yul lha'i thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa/ mi nad phyugs nad gdon bgegs/ 'byung po'i 'tshe ba/ blo nyes/ mi kha dgra gyod 'khon gsum 'khrugs rtsod nog brjod/ nang rkun/ gangs zhod/ mu ge glo bur gyi rkyen ngan/ phung byed kyi sri ngan/ byad dang rbod gtong / gshin gson gyi 'khrul snang bsnyen sgrub dang 'chad nyan gyi bar chad dang / rmis ltas mtshan ltas ngan pa sogs 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig ltung dang / /bla ma mchog la mnyam 'grogs shor ba dang / /srung ma rgya mtsho'i thugs dang 'gal ba sogs sdig sgrib thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ /rmongs dang bag med le lo'i gzhan dbang gis/ /srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa kun/ /da lta nyid du byang zhing dag nas ni/ /rjes brtse can gyis 'tsho bar mdzad du gsol/ /yang / nang 'khrugs la sogs 'gal rkyen kun dang bral/ /mthun rkyen tshang zhing sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin/ /chos dang mthun pa'i bsam pa'i don rnams kun/ /gegs med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /ljongs 'di'i mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i ma rung gdon bgegs dang / /dgra jag gcan rkun phyugs god gangs log sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /gnas 'di'i bdag dang yul 'di'i gzhi bdag rnams/ /khong khro gdug rtsub sdug bsngal kun zhi nas/ /tshe ring gzil che 'khor 'bangs longs spyod 'phel/
